topic: Extract text and tables from PDF files

defects.detail: name uses 'PDF_Extract' with uppercase letters and underscores; must be lowercase with hyphens only
description starts with 'You can extract' using second person; must use third person with 'what' and 'when' clauses
command uses backslash path 'scripts\extract_text.py'; must use forward slashes for cross-platform compatibility
command references 'scripts/extract_tables.py' which does not exist; file must be created or reference removed
